comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Sorry, I may not have been coherent enough; happens sometimes when I'm giddy about future stuff. To clarify:

Noblewoman's soap: This quest is indeed in GAMA right now, and available to everyone, either at the very start of a character's creation, or at a ridiculously low adventure fame level.
Manchester quest: Requires Soap quest pre-completed, and a patch not yet released in GAMA. The patch will be released in the future, when Atlantis concludes and "Age of Revolution" begins with Chapter 1. If present hastened release trends continue, we're talking end of 2016 (really hope not for complex reasons), or beginning of 2017.

Sorry for any confusion I might've caused.
